name: Swap sides
author: wizard
description: On the AI apps desktop, a button in the chats sidebar's header (or ⌥⇧L) puts the chats sidebar on the right and the Apps column on the left; press it again to put them back. Folded rails, resize handles, slides and ⌥L / ⌥R (fold the left / right side) mirror too. The choice is kept on this device. The narrower one-app window keeps the usual layout.
